caption:
Been daydreaming about that Peaches & Brie Charcuterie Dip all week🤤🍑🧀

Sweet peaches, juicy blackberries, creamy Brie, crispy prosciutto, fresh thyme, and Aleppo hot honey baked until golden, bubbly, and perfect for scooping. It’s everything you love about a summer charcuterie board in one ridiculously good bite.🫠

Save this and send it to the friend who has to bring the wine. 🍷

Baked Peaches & Brie Charcuterie Dip 🍑🧀

2 ripe peaches, diced
1/2 cup blackberries
8 oz Brie, chopped
2 oz prosciutto, torn
1 tsp fresh thyme leaves
Kosher salt & black pepper
Aleppo Hot Honey (Comment “yum” and I’ll DM you the recipe.)

Add everything to a baking dish, pour over the hot honey, and sprinkle over salt and pepper. 

Bake at 425°F  for 12-15  minutes, until the Brie is melted and bubbling.

Remove from the oven, and drizzle over balsamic drizzle.
 
Serve warm with garlic rubbed crostini, or your favorite crackers and enjoy!
author: Frohneats
transcript: If there's one thing you need to try this summer, then make it my peaches and brie charcuterie dip. It's insanely delicious and so easy to make, combining sweet peaches, blackberries, prosciutto, fresh thyme, and a spicy Aleppo hot. And I just pop it in the oven until it's super melty and finish it with a truffle balsamic and ooh la la, there you go food fam, full recipe in the caption.
